long_description:
Yin Yoga, Immersive Soundscapes, and Group Reiki Energy Healing inside Conduit’s cinematic premiere room.

About this Event

This immersive experience weaves together long held yin yoga postures, live ambient soundscapes, and group Reiki energy healing to support deep nervous system restoration.
Hosted inside Conduit’s immersive movie premiere room, this unique collaboration blends cinematic sound, layered frequencies, deep stretching, and energetic support to create a multi sensory journey for the body and mind.
✨ Yin Yoga: Amanda Helen of Science & Magic
🎵 Live Soundscape: Jim Morgan and Arthur Hey of Conduit Sound + Stage
🤍 Reiki Energy Support: Joelle Anderson of Soulful Empowerment
